title: 第15章 真相1第16章 真相2
slug: 北侯世子反派的我背景逆天
lines: 萧粦的眼中流露出追忆之色。
虽然那一夜的场景无数次出现在他的梦中，但细想起来，竟然已经过了足足二十年。
“就在我们即将抵达天阙关，在朔州边陲的一间驿馆歇息的那个夜晚，却遭遇了祸端。”
“是什么？”面对这种震动天下的大案，能有幸了解其中真相，赵岚心魂也被勾动起来。
“是毒。”
“毒？有人给你们下毒！”
“左中卫百余人皆尽中毒，无一例外。”
“怎么可能！”
赵岚惊呼。
那可是羽林卫左中队，皇城精锐，其中最低境界都是归一境，究竟是什么人能掌控他们的行踪，并无声无息的下毒。
“我怀疑是高氏，但听说后来他也死了，但这不是最重要的，而是接下来······”
萧粦瞳孔微微缩了一下，似乎想起了不好的回忆。
“我祖父早年乃是江湖散修，曾偶然得过东海散仙【青虚子】一次指点，习得奇术龟息，所以我以龟息假死，五感尽失。”
赵岚又低声惊呼：“天下五大高手之一的青虚子！”
他平日对江湖中的奇闻轶事很感兴趣，知道江湖中人颇喜欢给人评资排名，而“天下五大高手”就是已经流传了千年的老字号，在江湖中颇有含金量。
虽不至于就是真正的天下前五，但也必然是天底下最顶尖的那一批高人。
其中那青虚子早已得其名上百年之久。居于东海绝境孤岛“碧海仙山”，性情孤傲怪异，不与世同。
还有裴苏他爹镇北侯裴竣也是在近几年被列为“天下五大高手”之一，将那位云游天下不知死活的“守一散人”给挤了下去。
“没错，若不是我习成龟息，岂能假死骗过暗中之人的眼睛，不知过了多久，我幽幽醒来，却发现位于峡谷腹地，身边都是同僚、还有诸多士兵尸体。
“我的目光看向了不远处的乌匣，长十尺，宽五尺，便是我们此次死命护送的神刀龙雀乌木匣。”
赵岚顿时提心吊胆起来。
“龙雀被盗了？！”
“我也怀疑，所以我走上前去，打开了乌匣。”
说到此处，萧粦闭上了眼睛，全身忍不住发颤起来。
“然后呢，龙雀在不在那？”
萧粦未回应，而是问了一个另一个问题。
“岚儿，你说当今陛下······为什么要闭关崆峒山？”
“啊？我不知道。”
圣上的事距离赵岚太过遥远，怎敢妄加猜测。
“我打开了乌木匣，龙雀刀光刺得我眼睛发痛，然后，我看见了，让我无数次从噩梦中惊醒的场景，也是我这辈子永远不可能忘记的一幕······”
“是什么？”赵岚的心也提到嗓子眼。
“龙雀刀尖，插着当今圣上的头颅！”
裴苏直直看着面前的黑袍老者，良久平息心境。
“是的少主，天子早已死了二十年，崆峒闭关不过是老爷与皇后联手营造的惊天骗局。”
裴苏不语。
这骗局，未免有些过于骇世了。
大晋天子李乾，当年在残酷的九子夺嫡中获胜登基，此后数十载，整军经武，筹谋战略，收复失地数百，有雄图大略，亦有治国之才，乃真正不世枭雄。

There was a look of reminiscence in Xiao Li's eyes.
Although the scene of that night appeared in his dreams countless times, when he thought about it carefully, it turned out that a full twenty years had passed.
"On the night when we were about to arrive at Tianque Pass and rest at a posthouse on the border of Shuozhou, we encountered a disaster."
"What is it?" Faced with such a major case that shocked the world, Zhao Lan's heart and soul was stirred by the chance to understand the truth.
"It's poison."
"Poison? Someone poisoned you!"
"More than a hundred people in the left center guard were all poisoned, without exception."
"How is that possible!"
Zhao Lan exclaimed.
That was the Zuo Squadron of the Yulin Guards, the elite of the Imperial City, among whom the lowest realm was the Guiyi Realm. Who could control their whereabouts and poison them silently.
"I suspected it was Mr. Gao, but I heard that he also died later, but that's not the most important thing, but what happens next..."
Xiao Lin's pupils shrank slightly, as if he remembered bad memories.
"My grandfather was a wandering cultivator in his early years. He accidentally received guidance from the Sanxian of the East China Sea [Qing Xuzi] and learned the magical art of Turtle Breath. So I used the Turtle Breath to fake my death and lost all my five senses."
Zhao Lan exclaimed in a low voice: "Qing Xuzi, one of the top five masters in the world!"
He is usually very interested in the anecdotes in the world. He knows that people in the world like to evaluate and rank people, and the "Five Masters in the World" are time-honored brands that have been passed down for thousands of years and are quite valuable in the world.
Although they are not truly among the top five in the world, they must still be among the top experts in the world.
Among them, Qing Xuzi has already had his name for hundreds of years. Living on an isolated island in the East China Sea called "Blue Sea Fairy Mountain", he has an aloof and weird personality and is different from the rest of the world.
Pei Su's father, Pei Jun, the Marquis of Zhenbei, has also been listed as one of the "Five Masters in the World" in recent years, ousting the "Shou Yi Sanren" who traveled around the world without knowing whether to live or die.
"That's right, if I hadn't become accustomed to turtle breathing, how could I have faked my death and deceived the eyes of the people in the dark? I don't know how long it took, but I woke up faintly, only to find that I was in the heart of the canyon, surrounded by my colleagues and the corpses of many soldiers.
"I looked at the ebony box not far away. It was ten feet long and five feet wide. It was the ebony box of the Divine Sword Dragon Bird that we were escorting desperately this time. "
Zhao Lan suddenly became worried.
"The dragon bird was stolen? ! "
"I was suspicious too, so I stepped forward and opened the black box. "
Speaking of this, Xiao Lin closed his eyes and couldn't help but tremble all over.
"Then, is Longque there? "
Xiao Lin did not respond, but asked another question.
"Lan'er, do you think His Majesty...why does he want to retreat to Kongtong Mountain? "
"ah? I have no idea. "
Zhao Lan's affairs are too far away from the Holy Sage, so how can he dare to make rash guesses.
"I opened the ebony box, and the light of the dragon bird knife hurt my eyes. Then, I saw a scene that woke me up from nightmares countless times. It is also a scene that I will never forget in my life..."
"What is it? "Zhao Lan's heart was in her throat.
"The head of the current Holy Emperor is inserted into the tip of the dragon bird sword! "
······
"His Majesty's... head? ! "
Pei Su looked straight at the old man in black robe in front of him and calmed down for a long time.
"Yes, young master, the emperor has been dead for twenty years, and the retreat in Kongtong is just a shocking scam created by the master and the queen. "
Pei Su was silent.
This scam is a bit too shocking.
Li Qian, the emperor of the Jin Dynasty, won the throne in the cruel battle of nine sons. In the following decades, he organized the army, planned strategies, and regained hundreds of lost territories. He had ambitious plans and the talent to govern the country. He was a truly unparalleled hero.
